description: Fingerprint of the locally rebuilt corpus (data/examples.jsonl). The corpus text is not distributed; this lets a user check that python -m formal_si.data.fetch && python -m formal_si.data.build reproduces the corpus used for every archived result.
provenance: The original runs (2026-11-04) cloned each default branch without recording commits. On 2026-11-05 the same repositories were cloned at the commits above and rebuilt with src/formal_si/data/build.py; the result was byte-identical to the corpus used for the archived runs (same SHA-256).
